content:
“Zap that thirst!”

**Cola Nut** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Nuka-Cola drinks are increasingly beneficial.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Nuka-Cola drinks are now three times as beneficial. | 00393F4C | 
| ★ | 1 | Nuka-Cola drinks are now twice as beneficial. | 00393F4B | 

- On Nuka-Cola alcohols, stacks additively with Party Boy/Party Girl.
- The perk works only with drinks and does not benefit Nuka-Cola candy or Nuka-Cola Quantum candy.

The name of the perk is a pun on the kola nut, which derives cola flavor in sodas.
